files.CSXS/manifest.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<ExtensionManifest
  Version="6.0"
  ExtensionBundleId="com.feugee.fxsearch"
  ExtensionBundleVersion="1.1.2"
  ExtensionBundleName="Feugee FX Search"
  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">

  <!--
    Two extensions, one bundle:
      .panel    library - favorites, aliases, overrides, snapshots, settings
      .hub      invisible, starts with AE, installs the launcher, warms the popup
    The Ctrl+Space popup itself is native ScriptUI (jsx/popup.jsx): a CEP
    window cannot be hidden, and booting one per keypress costs 1.2-1.5 s.
  -->
  <ExtensionList>
    <Extension Id="com.feugee.fxsearch.panel" Version="1.1.2" />
    <Extension Id="com.feugee.fxsearch.hub" Version="1.1.2" />
  </ExtensionList>

  <ExecutionEnvironment>
    <HostList>
      <Host Name="AEFT" Version="[0.0,99.9]" />
    </HostList>
    <LocaleList>
      <Locale Code="All" />
    </LocaleList>
    <RequiredRuntimeList>
      <RequiredRuntime Name="CSXS" Version="9.0" />
    </RequiredRuntimeList>
  </ExecutionEnvironment>

  <DispatchInfoList>

    <Extension Id="com.feugee.fxsearch.panel">
      <DispatchInfo>
        <Resources>
          <MainPath>./index.html</MainPath>
          <ScriptPath>./jsx/host.jsx</ScriptPath>
          <CEFCommandLine>
            <Parameter>--v=0</Parameter>
            <Parameter>--allow-file-access</Parameter>
            <Parameter>--allow-file-access-from-files</Parameter>
          </CEFCommandLine>
        </Resources>
        <Lifecycle>
          <AutoVisible>true</AutoVisible>
        </Lifecycle>
        <UI>
          <Type>Panel</Type>
          <Menu>Feugee FX Search</Menu>
          <Geometry>
            <Size>
              <Width>360</Width>
              <Height>600</Height>
            </Size>
            <MinSize>
              <Width>190</Width>
              <Height>160</Height>
            </MinSize>
            <MaxSize>
              <Width>2400</Width>
              <Height>2400</Height>
            </MaxSize>
          </Geometry>
        </UI>
      </DispatchInfo>
    </Extension>

    <Extension Id="com.feugee.fxsearch.hub">
      <DispatchInfo>
        <Resources>
          <MainPath>./hub.html</MainPath>
          <ScriptPath>./jsx/host.jsx</ScriptPath>
          <CEFCommandLine>
            <Parameter>--v=0</Parameter>
          </CEFCommandLine>
        </Resources>
        <Lifecycle>
          <AutoVisible>false</AutoVisible>
          <StartOn>
            <Event>applicationActivate</Event>
            <Event>com.adobe.csxs.events.ApplicationActivate</Event>
          </StartOn>
        </Lifecycle>
        <UI>
          <Type>Custom</Type>
          <Geometry>
            <Size>
              <Width>1</Width>
              <Height>1</Height>
            </Size>
          </Geometry>
        </UI>
      </DispatchInfo>
    </Extension>

  </DispatchInfoList>
</ExtensionManifest>
